headline: The School Committee approved an informational flyer detailing the proposed $8.8 million Trottier Middle School roof replacement ahead of Annual Town Meeting.
synopsis: In March 2026, the Southborough School Committee focused on public outreach regarding the proposed Trottier Middle School roof replacement. The committee reviewed and revised a draft one-page informational flyer ahead of the April 11, 2026 Annual Town Meeting vote. Members emphasized clearly distinguishing between the total gross appropriation required by the Massachusetts School Building Authority and the town's net cost after grant reimbursements. The committee voted 4-0 to approve the edited flyer for distribution to voters.

top_items.title: Trottier Middle School roof project flyer approval
top_items.why: The School Committee approved a one-page informational flyer explaining the $8.8 million Trottier Middle School roof funding request ahead of the April 11, 2026 Annual Town Meeting vote.
top_items.body: The School Committee reviewed and finalized an informational flyer explaining the condition of the Trottier Middle School roof and the scope of the $8.8 million capital project. Members focused on presenting the financing clearly, ensuring the document distinguishes between the total gross appropriation required by the Massachusetts School Building Authority and Southborough's net cost following state grant reimbursement. The committee voted 4-0 to adopt the edited flyer.
